items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon 出来了。Argon 9 月 30 日宣布、10 月 13 日放出，Carbon 10 月 28 日宣布、11 月 10 日才对所有付费开发者开放，看着是四周一个旗舰。可 Google 5 月说好 6 月出的
items.summary:
Gemini 4 Carbon 出来了。Argon 9 月 30 日宣布、10 月 13 日放出，Carbon 10 月 28 日宣布、11 月 10 日才对所有付费开发者开放，看着是四周一个旗舰。可 Google 5 月说好 6 月出的 3.5 Pro 被直接取消了，Reuters 10 月 1 日报的，Bloomberg 报道原因是编码成绩没达标，DeepMind 也换了管理层，我觉得这个节奏更像补课。再看 Antigravity 在 JetBrains 调查里工作中使用率 6%，Claude Code 是 39%，Google 靠低价抢人也说得通。

Google 10 月 28 日的对比表里，Terminal-Bench 4.0 是 Carbon 65.2%，GPT-6 Astra 59.1%，Opus 5.5 59.6%；256k 到 1M 长上下文的 GraphWalks 是 96.2% 对 71.8% 和 66.8%，这项是 Google 自己跑的；FrontierSWE 2 它 61.2%，输给 Astra 的 65.5% 和 Opus 的 62.3%，OSWorld-2.1 的 81.5% 也输给 Opus 的 87.2%。而且表里的对手是 Fable 5.1，11 月 9 日刚出的 Fable 5.2 不在里面。

独立榜单更冷静。Artificial Analysis 综合指数 Fable 5.2 是 65，Carbon 60，HLE-Diamond 是 80% 对 69%；不过 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上 Carbon 的 65 反过来高于 Fable 5.2 的 60。它的编码 Agent 指数 59，Claude Code 配 Opus 5.5 是 62。AA-Omniscience（知识可靠性）Fable 5.2 是 67，Carbon 54。LMArena 人类投票 Carbon 1526，跟 Argon 的 1522 在误差内打平，只有 4282 票，是预览值，Fable 5.2 还没评分。CursorBench 上 Carbon 以 60.4% 排第一，我只当其中一个参考。

它的长项在读图和读长文档。上下文是 100 万 token，输入输出共用；Google 自己的表里读图表的 Chartography 是 72.5% 对 Opus 5.5 的 66.3%，它和 Artificial Analysis 合作做的多模态知识 Agent 基准排第二，仅次于 Fable 5.2，每任务成本不到第一名的六分之一；Gray Swan 的间接提示注入测试攻击成功率 0%，Google 说这是第一个做到的模型。这几项都是 Google 自己公布的数字。

价格是 $2/$10 每百万 token，只有 Fable 5.2（$8/$40）的四分之一，但只到 11 月 30 日，12 月 1 日起 $4/$20，Argon 也一样，到时候是 Fable 5.2 的一半，跟 GPT-5.6 Sol 现在的价格持平。Artificial Analysis 算每任务成本用的就是 $4/$20 的标准价，Carbon high 得 60 分花 $7.76，Fable 5.2 high 得 62 分花 $9.08，max 得 65 分要 $26.54。按涨价后的价格算，Carbon 比 Fable 5.2 high 便宜约 15%，分数低 2 分。

缺点是慢。Artificial Analysis 测 high 档首个答案要等约 67 秒，跑一个任务 23 到 26 分钟；Plotly 自己跑数据分析题，Carbon 单题中位数 93 秒，是 Argon 23 秒的四倍。Google 自己也说多数编码和知识工作用 Argon 就行，Carbon 留给最难的活。至于「长任务」，METR 9 月起就不更新任务时长了，最后测的 Mythos Preview 在 50% 成功率下约 17 小时、80% 下约 3 小时，Carbon 没有这类独立数据。我觉得它适合读几百页文档、看图表蓝图这类不赶时间的活，需要来回交互的就别选它。 https://t.co/AvgZXR6jfL

items.title: Google turned on Gemini 4 Carbon yesterday and buried the real story in the fine print: introductory pricing of $2 per m
items.summary:
Google turned on Gemini 4 Carbon yesterday and buried the real story in the fine print: introductory pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens jumps to $4 and $20 the moment November ends. A model good enough to ship at a discount, priced to double the second the launch headlines fade.

What it's actually good at is the interesting part. Carbon tops CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity's WANDR and Zapier's AutomationBench, and Google says it finds zero day vulnerabilities in major SaaS products within two hours of internal testing. On defense it blocked 99% of an adaptive red team's attack paths and scored a clean 0% attack success rate on Gray Swan's prompt injection benchmark. Offense and defense, same model, same week.

That pairing is where this gets uncomfortable rather than impressive. A model this good at finding exploits is, by definition, a model this good at writing them. Google's answer is a Fairwind Program giving vetted defenders early access, which only helps if attackers don't get their own frontier model with the same two hour turnaround.

Zoom out and the cybersecurity benchmark race has gotten crowded fast. Semgrep's latest numbers put https://t.co/MAWoH6xO1K's GLM-5.3 at roughly Opus 4.8 level on IDOR detection for about a seventh of the cost per finding, $0.15 versus $1.04. Neither touches the actual leaders on that test, Opus 5 at 65.6% and GPT-5.6 Luna at 48%. Carbon wasn't entered in that particular benchmark, but the market shape is clear: a frontier tier racing on raw capability, a value tier racing on cost per finding, and most security teams ending up running both.

My read: the November 30 price jump is the tell. Google rarely discounts a model it isn't a little worried will look expensive next to whatever Anthropic or OpenAI ship in the next few weeks.

items.title: Voters deliver "AI earthquake," rebuking tech and billionaires
items.summary:
AI had its "official debut" as the biggest issue in American politics, former New York Assemblymember and RAISE Act author Alex Bores told Axios. "AI is reaching into every part of our society and economy and it's now crystal clear it's impacting every part of our politics, too." [...] Voters showed deep distrust of the AI race Tuesday, approving dozens of data center moratoriums and electing a raft of candidates who favor slowing a $10 trillion buildout, including in Texas — the epicenter of the boom.

Why it matters: In an election that hinged on an affordability crisis for many Americans, voters made it clear they view Silicon Valley's AI ambitions not as a technological miracle, but as a resource-draining threat to their wallets and communities. [...] Democratic challengers successfully weaponized AI policy, ousting Republicans in Ohio, Wisconsin, Arizona and Pennsylvania.
   Democratic groups had poured ads into these districts attacking GOP incumbents for a 2025 vote that would've neutered state AI legislation.
   AI safety advocates won or were poised to win races on Tuesday that will expand their coalition in the new Congress, including Colorado's Manny Rutinel and Minnesota's Matt Little.

items.title: Có Nên Học Công Nghệ Thông Tin? Học CNTT Có Khó Không?
items.summary:
Nên học Công nghệ thông tin nếu bạn yêu thích công nghệ, có khả năng tư duy logic và sẵn sàng dành thời gian học tập, thực hành lu dài. Ngành CNTT phù hợp với người muốn sử dụng máy tính và phần mềm để giải quyết vấn đề thực tế, không chỉ với những học sinh đã biết lập trình từ THPT.

Tuy nhiên, quyết định chọn ngành cần dựa trên sở thích, năng lực và mục tiêu nghề nghiệp thay vì kỳ vọng rằng học CNTT chắc chắn có thu nhập cao.

### Những Lý Do Nên Cn Nhắc Ngành Công Nghệ Thông Tin [...] ## Ai Phù Hợp Với Ngành Công Nghệ Thông Tin?

Ngành Công nghệ thông tin phù hợp với người yêu thích công nghệ, có tư duy logic, kiên trì giải quyết vấn đề và sẵn sàng tự học. Không nhất thiết phải biết lập trình trước khi vào đại học, nhưng học sinh nên có hứng thú tìm hiểu cách các hệ thống máy tính và ứng dụng hoạt động.

### Những Tố Chất Phù Hợp Với Ngành CNTT

Dưới đy là một số đặc điểm có thể giúp học sinh học tập và phát triển trong ngành. [...] Con gái hoàn toàn có thể học Công nghệ thông tin nếu yêu thích công nghệ và có định hướng nghề nghiệp phù hợp. Giới tính không quyết định khả năng lập trình, tư duy logic hay cơ hội phát triển trong ngành CNTT. Điều quan trọng là người học có kiến thức chuyên môn, sự kiên trì và tinh thần chủ động học hỏi.

items.title: Robotics Programming: Methods, Languages and Tools
items.summary:
Safety and Speed Limits – During manual teaching operations, OSHA regulations mandate limiting maximum robot speed to less than 250mm/s to maintain operator safety.

## Introduction

Robotics programming is the work of turning a robot arm, a cobot or a mobile base into a machine that performs a specific, repeatable job. It ranges from jogging an industrial robot to a weld start point with a teach pendant to writing C++ nodes that plan collision-free paths from camera and LIDAR data. [...] The International Federation of Robotics (IFR) counted 542,000 industrial robots installed in 2024 and 4,664,000 in operational use worldwide.  Robot vendors use different languages, command names and settings to express similar motion concepts. Joint moves control movement through joint space, while linear moves guide the tool along a straight Cartesian path. The following examples cover ABB, KUKA, FANUC and Universal Robots. [...] The approach to robotics programming depends on the application. The simple pick-and-place operation may use positions recorded through a teach pendant, while a robot working in a changing environment may need software for perception, path planning and decision-making. Choosing a suitable method means considering task complexity, hardware capabilities and the people who will maintain the system.

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Accelerating Physical Intelligence — Google DeepMind
items.summary: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them. This enhances dexterity, reliability, and safety to help robots step out of the lab and into more unstructured, real-world environments, where they can assist people with a greater range of tasks. [...] Using our embodied reasoning model (Gemini Robotics ER) to keep track of the workflow, and the Gemini Robotics 2.5 actions model to control its hands and arms, the robot reaches into supply bins, picks up metal automotive brackets, and places them into sequencing containers, all while correcting for any gaps. Achieving a 96% success rate, this pilot shows promising progress toward widespread real-world industrial applications. [...] Gemini Robotics 2.5 uses inference-time reasoning guidance to steer around physical hazards in real-time. Much like safety classifiers add a protective layer around Gemini’s responses, this guidance allows the robot to navigate complex environments securely. In our evaluations, this capability boosted safe task completion around obstacles by 33% and around nearby people by 43%.

items.summary:
AI 今天这波新闻,全是给搞技术的人看的

安全成了新标配
OpenAI 上线 Control Room,能在 35 秒内叫停任何不安全的模型任务
每个做智能体推理的研究任务,现在都要先过"安全案例"审批

推理在疯狂提速降本
对 vLLM 的独立测试显示:连续批处理(continuous batching)把吞吐拉高 2.91 倍,整体比原生 transformers 快 3.86 倍
Netflix 的事实核查系统重做后,单条成本直降 52.4%,解释和人工标注的重合度升到约 82%

本地化、私有化是大趋势
一位律师用 8 张二手 Nvidia V100 自建私有 AI 服务器,跑 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash,最高 215 tokens/秒,把敏感法律文件全留在本地
AMD 推 Instinct Coder 355,本地跑 GLM 5.3,敏感代码不出公司;还发了 Developer Assistant 和 Project Zenith 开发环境

隐私翻车警示
Weill Cornell 和华盛顿州机构被曝把患者隐私数据(PHI)误传进 AI 工具,包括直接用 ChatGPT 写病历
提醒所有人:往第三方 AI 丢数据之前,先想清楚合规

模型结构还在进化
新方法 HOPE 给 MoE 大模型做"专家剪枝",不用额外训练,智能体编程任务最高提升 6.1%
Qwen3.5-122B 有 95% 的显存,其实都压在闲置的专家 MLP 上

一句话:模型在变快、变便宜、变私有,但安全和合规正在变成硬门槛
